title: Integrate controlled title lifecycle and kernel gate evidence
goal: Reconcile child evidence and achieve orderly shutdown after an explicitly bounded real-title checkpoint on Linux and native Windows.
acceptance: Record exact SP/MP generation/runtime identities and reviewed import/data-variable coverage, with every remaining service failing diagnostically
Replace abrupt process-exit evidence with a deliberately bounded diagnostic stop followed by real thread/runtime teardown and verified resource release

Keep the parent gate open for any failing child, missing platform evidence or unreviewed service needed by the checkpoint; split newly discovered implementation work rather than widening this task silently
validation: Repeat title load/checkpoint/diagnostic-stop/shutdown in isolated profiles, including interruption and malformed-pointer failures
Reconcile all child cases and rerun affected regression/sanitizer checks; no graphics, playable boot or full-kernel compatibility claim
